gui.aeroscapes_navigation.lower: Show terrain 16 blocks lower on both maps
gui.aeroscapes_navigation.higher: Show terrain 16 blocks higher on both maps
gui.aeroscapes_navigation.help: Both maps show terrain within this height range, including islands below other islands. −/+ select a fixed layer; click this button to follow your height or restore Xaero's native view. Only explored, loaded terrain can be mapped; wait for the map to refresh after switching. Keys are configurable in Controls → Aeroscapes map layers.
